requirement.statement: 一个 run 的 input、config、state、output、controller/node sidecars 与 profile-owned durable state SHALL 由同一个 CAS-versioned checkpoint拥有；profile runtime不得建立并列可写store。

case.name: Ctrl profile
case.then: 变化 SHALL 作为一个checkpoint transition提交并从同一version恢复

case.name: Data profile
case.then: 变化 SHALL 作为一个checkpoint transition提交，不得另写并列data-graph authority

requirement.statement: AI Workflow profile state MAY 保存外部 Agent actor/session/instance的opaque stable references与receipts，但 MUST NOT 复制conversation、history、compaction或external actor state；外部runtime继续拥有其execution authority。

case.name: 仅引用恢复
case.given: checkpoint保存一个external runtime stable reference
case.then: profile SHALL 通过host adapter解析该reference，不得从checkpoint伪造或复制external actor state
